title: A loan is saved with its outbox event
statement: Opening or returning a loan MUST save the loan's change and the event it raises (Loan opened, Tool returned) to the outbox in one transaction, so either both are saved or neither is; once committed, both MUST survive a restart of the server.

title: A loan is kept with its return
statement: A loan MUST be kept, with its return once it has one, for as long as the library runs: nothing deletes a loan, since the outcome measures (TL-BO01, TL-BO02) count every loan ever opened and every return.
